_about: Public-domain Thomas M'Crie the elder (1772-1835, Secession minister in Edinburgh, historian of the Scottish Reformation) for the Word Hoard: The Works of Thomas M'Crie (Edinburgh: W. Blackwood, 1856-57), vols 2-4 (Life of Andrew Melville; the Reformation in Italy and Spain; Review of Tales of My Landlord, On the Unity of the Church, sermons), and Lectures on the Book of Esther (New York: R. Carter, 1838), raw Internet Archive OCR. His Life of John Knox is left to the English Reformers and Knox thread. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 11 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

mccrie-esther-1838: Lectures on the Book of Esther (New York: R. Carter, 1838)
mccrie-works-v2: The Works of Thomas M'Crie, vol. 2: Life of Andrew Melville (Edinburgh: W. Blackwood, 1856)
mccrie-works-v3: The Works of Thomas M'Crie, vol. 3: The Reformation in Italy; The Reformation in Spain (Edinburgh: W. Blackwood, 1856)
mccrie-works-v4: The Works of Thomas M'Crie, vol. 4: Review of Tales of My Landlord; On the Unity of the Church; Sermons (Edinburgh: W. Blackwood, 1857)
